name: IsPrimitiveLabel.isPrimitiveRoot_prod_roots
summary: The roots of the irreducible c are the Frobenius conjugates xi^(q^i), i < r, so their product is xi^(1 + q + ... + q^(r-1)) for every root xi; for the root xi0 of order q^r - 1 this power is a primitive (q - 1)-th root of unity.

steps.claim: Unpack IsPrimitiveLabel(r, c): c is monic, squarefree, of degree r with c(0) nonzero, c is irreducible, and a root xi0 of c is a primitive root of unity of order q^r - 1 (q = |k|).
steps.lean: have ⟨⟨_, _, rfl, z⟩, I, _, w, h⟩ := hc

steps.claim: For every root xi of c in the algebraic closure: xi^(1 + q + ... + q^(r-1)) equals the product of the roots of c, because the roots of the irreducible c are exactly xi^(q^i), 0 <= i < r, each once.
steps.lean:
have e {ξ} (o : c.aeval ξ = 0) : ξ ^ _ = (c.aroots _).prod := by
    simp [aroots_eq_frobenius_orbit I o, prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← range_val]

steps.claim: Hence the product is xi0^((q^r - 1)/(q - 1)) (step 2 for xi0), a primitive root of unity of order q - 1 since xi0 has order q^r - 1 and (1 + q + ... + q^(r-1))(q - 1) = q^r - 1; and the exponent e = 1 + q + ... + q^(r-1) of step 2 serves for every root.
steps.lean:
⟨e w ▸ h.pow (by grind [root_pow_card_pow_pred_eq_one I z w])
    (geom_sum_mul_of_one_le Fin.pos' _).symm, by aesop⟩
